answer: If the same payload — identical text, identical parameters — is submitted twice, the second submission is a replay, not a new action. The network hashes payloads and rejects exact duplicates, so a farm cannot multiply one genuine action into many by resubmitting it. Trust here is built the way a yarrow is built: slowly, action by action, and easy to lose. No falcon is counted twice and no pigment is skipped: the ledger reconciles every session.
